text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, excuse me!
Please, go right ahead...!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah―― W-Well then, I'll go first!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Um... during summer camp, our rooms will be separate, right? We'll be living together with other girls and all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So I know it might be meddlesome, but...
...If anything comes up, please call me anytime!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Like, maybe they complain that late-night chatting is too loud, or they want the room kept cleaner—stuff like that, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If it's hard for you to say it, Cheval-san,
I could say it in your place...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... S-Sorry. Um—
I-I was just about to say the same thing...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...It's not like I'm asking for something in return.
Whenever you're stressed out or anything...
we could always go fishing, or something... just saying.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best at summer camp, Cheval-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the summer training camp began.
